title: Human DEAH-box helicase 8 regulates HSF1-mediated stress response and cancer-associated pre-mRNA splicing in tumour cells.
abstract: Transcription factor heat shock factor 1 (HSF1) orchestrates the cellular stress response, promoting malignant transformation, unchecked proliferation, and stress-resilient survival of tumour cells. We set out to discover potentially druggable regulators of HSF1 activation and identified DEAH-box RNA helicase 8 (DHX8).
